punchline: People aged 29, 39 or 49 are overrepresented among first-time marathon runners by 48 percent.
thirty_sec: Researchers Adam Alter and Hal Hershfield found that people whose age ends in 9 were 48 percent overrepresented among first-time marathoners. Daniel Pink's take: a symbolic ending, like the close of a decade, pushes people to act. Midpoints can do it too. Project teams often coast until halfway, then surge, and basketball teams down by one point at halftime win more often than teams up by one. Noticing where you are in time changes how you move.
question: Did a birthday or the end of a year ever push you to start something?
